paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak bar Shila, Rav Ḥisda's student. He said in the name of Rav Mattana, who cited Rav Ḥisda, Kiddushin (32a). If so, he did not speak [directly] in Rav Ḥisda's name; from where do we know he was Rav Ḥisda's student? In Jerusalem Talmud, Bammeh Tomin, halakhah 1: R. Yoḥanan bar Shila.
